column1: # The tesseract language models the OCR bundle carries and devenv and CI read with, from tessdata_fast at
# TESSDATA_COMMIT: orientation and script detection, script/Latin and script/Greek for every language of those
# scripts with its diacritics, a model for each other script the automatic OCR language reads
# (ScriptDetection.LANGUAGE_BY_SCRIPT), and German for the tests of an explicit OCR language. Model path, then SHA-256.
